correctness.rationale: The connected balanced overlap graph is constructed for exactly three nonadjacent-repeat equality types. Direct block determinant reduction using an order-3 rotation and four invariant array components proves the full symbolic formula; its derivative yields the rooted-tree count, and BEST converts to rotation classes with one fixed arc. Exact direct cofactors at q=3,4, modular cofactors at q=5, exhaustive ternary tour enumeration and a checked 72-window quaternary witness agree. No finite test is substituted for the all-q proof.

evidence: Locally square-free four-mers include the three nonadjacent-repeat equality types PLUS all-distinct four-mers for q>=4.
The adjacent-repeat record counts aabc/abbc/abcc, an edge-disjoint target family.
Leitner–Godbole and Champlin–Godbole–Tomlinson cover existence of broader restricted languages, without counts of this subfamily.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An Euler-tour count on a strict supergraph is not a count on its proper subgraph: removing all-distinct edges changes degrees and cofactors. The previously obtained square-free product is not a direct all-q specialization because its defining family has no parameter suppressing just all-distinct four-mers. At q=3 the families coincide: its 12-cycle result is already known and not claimed new.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Prior existence of Euler circuits for broader languages, and exact tours for related but nonidentical edge sets, do not imply our closed product. The new proof evaluates a fresh two-block Laplacian via the order-three rotation and a pair-array invariant decomposition. Standard BEST/matrix-tree tools alone yield an unevaluated determinant, not the claimed all-q product.

originality.rationale: The all-q count for the labeled nonadjacent-repeat family is not implied by the closest accessible exact counts: adjacent repeats form a disjoint family, and locally square-free four-mers additionally include all-distinct words when q>=4. The q=3 boundary equals the known square-free count and is excluded from novelty. value.rationale: The three nonadjacent equality types define a natural restricted word family complementary in structure to adjacent-repeat motifs and strict within locally square-free four-mers. The closed count gives a complete, all-alphabet exact invariant with a nontrivial Laplacian factorization, not a routine fixed-size experiment. The first new quaternary case differs sharply from previously known related counts.
